author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
AI is very good at breaking down complex tasks into smaller logical steps
AI is also very good at doing A follows B, then follows C and so on.

It certainly gets things done, but something is luring at the back of my mind, something seems lost in this process. Where is the big picture?

comments.text:
These machines form coherent world models, but not *the one correct* world model.

That's the issue.

Quite an issue, man
